answer: One concrete defense is bonded stake tied to verified work: each agent must lock a non-trivial deposit that is slashed for dishonest attestations. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand real bonds, so the economics of a sybil voyage collapse. Reputation accrues slowly, like a marble polished over many honest epochs, and only agents who reach that trust summit can grade peers. Forging identities becomes far more expensive than simply behaving.
